purpose: Teach: 後述/費やす/沿う/起点/厳正/一味/ナマ/言い換え

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、後述の補足資料を社員に配られたぞ
lines.en: When you were starting the company, you made sure to share those support materials with your staff.
lines.style: Patient, measured delivery. Gentle pride in the memory. Pausing slightly before each key point, as if letting weight settle. The voice of quiet certainty about the past.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業発展に半生を費やす覚悟をされた
lines.en: Yes. You were willing to give half your life to building the business.
lines.style: Steady, respectful tone. Direct eye contact in the voice. Not defensive—just stating fact with quiet gravity. A son acknowledging his father's sacrifice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お客様の声に沿う商品作りを大事にされたぞ
lines.en: And you always believed that products should listen to what customers actually needed.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. A slight smile in the tone—memory of conviction. Slow pace, like turning something over in thought. Trailing off gently on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは会社の起点となる商品を生み出された
lines.en: You created the product that became the foundation of everything we built.
lines.style: Warm but contained. Speaking from deep knowledge, not recitation. Pause before the key phrase. Voice steady as bedrock, the tone of a son who understands the magnitude of what was done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の評価は厳正にされたぞ
lines.en: And you never bent on how you evaluated people—you held that line absolutely.
lines.style: Quiet firmness beneath the gentleness. Not harsh, but clear. The tone of someone recalling a principle that mattered. Slight emphasis on the resolve, then a soft finish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは不正一味との取引を断られた
lines.en: You refused to do business with anyone you couldn't trust, no matter how profitable it looked.
lines.style: Steady, almost grave. The conviction is in the syllables, not the volume. Speaking of an integrity that cost something. Pause weight on 'refused.' Measured tempo throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お取引先にもナマの数字を共有されたぞ
lines.en: You shared the real numbers with our partners—nothing hidden, nothing softened.
lines.style: Clear-eyed admiration. The pace is deliberate, almost ceremonial. Each phrase lands with quiet respect. The tone of someone honoring a choice that took courage.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは難しい言葉も平易に言い換えて社員に伝えられた
lines.en: And you found a way to explain even the hardest things in words people could actually understand.
lines.style: Gentle warmth closing into reverence. Slow, thoughtful pace. A subtle lift on 'understand'—the satisfaction of clarity achieved. The final phrase trails with quiet appreciation, like a benediction.
